c_sop = '#4C72B0'
c_health = '#E69F00'

# Lighter versions for model points
c_tau2_dot = '#D4787A'
c_sop_dot = '#7A9BC8'
c_health_dot = '#F0BE55'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.0, 3.2))

rows_config = [
    # (label, ypos, summary_color, summary_val, ci, models, dot_color)
    ('SOPBench', 0, c_sop, sop_summary, None, sop_models, c_sop_dot),
    (r'$\tau^2$-bench' + '\nexcl. incompl.', 1, c_tau2_light, tau2_excl_summary, tau2_excl_ci, [], None),
    (r'$\tau^2$-bench', 2, c_tau2, tau2_summary, tau2_ci, tau2_models, c_tau2_dot),
    ('Healthcare\npilot', 3, c_health, health_summary, None, health_models, c_health_dot),
]

for label, ypos, color, summary_val, ci, models, dot_color in rows_config:
    # Alternating background
    if ypos % 2 == 0:
        ax.axhspan(ypos - 0.45, ypos + 0.45, color='#f7f7f7', zorder=0)

    # Per-model points (jittered vertically)
    if models:
        n = len(models)
        jitter = np.linspace(-0.15, 0.15, n)
        for i, (mname, val) in enumerate(models):
            ax.scatter(val, ypos + jitter[i], marker='o', s=28,
                      c=dot_color, alpha=0.7, zorder=3, edgecolors='white',
                      linewidths=0.4)
            # Label extreme models
            if (ypos == 2 and mname == 'LLaMA'):
                ax.annotate(mname, (val, ypos + jitter[i]),
                           xytext=(-3, -10), textcoords='offset points',
                           fontsize=5.5, fontfamily='serif', color='#666666',
                           ha='center')
            elif (ypos == 2 and mname == 'Gemini'):
                ax.annotate(mname, (val, ypos + jitter[i]),
                           xytext=(0, 7), textcoords='offset points',
                           fontsize=5.5, fontfamily='serif', color='#666666',
                           ha='center')

    # CI whiskers
    if ci:
        ci_low, ci_high = ci
        ax.plot([ci_low, ci_high], [ypos, ypos], color=color,
                linewidth=2.0, zorder=4, solid_capstyle='butt')
        cap_h = 0.07
        for x in [ci_low, ci_high]:
            ax.plot([x, x], [ypos - cap_h, ypos + cap_h],
                    color=color, linewidth=1.5, zorder=4)

    # Summary diamond
    ax.scatter(summary_val, ypos, marker='D', s=130,
              c=color, edgecolors='white', linewidths=1.0, zorder=5)

    # Value annotation (right of rightmost element)
    rightmost = summary_val
    if models:
        rightmost = max(rightmost, max(v for _, v in models))
    if ci:
        rightmost = max(rightmost, ci[1])

    ax.text(rightmost + 2.5, ypos, f'+{summary_val:.1f} pp',
            ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold',
            color=color, fontfamily='serif')

    # N models annotation
    if models:
        n_str = f'n={len(models)}'
        leftmost = min(v for _, v in models)
        ax.text(leftmost - 2, ypos, n_str,
                ha='right', va='center', fontsize=6, color='#999999',
                fontfamily='serif', style='italic')

# Zero reference line
ax.axvline(x=0, color='#cccccc', linewidth=0.8, linestyle='-', zorder=1)

# Y-axis
ylabels = [r[0] for r in rows_config]
ax.set_yticks(range(4))
ax.set_yticklabels(ylabels, fontsize=8, fontfamily='serif')

              fontsize=9, fontfamily='serif')
ax.set_xlim(-8, 82)
ax.set_ylim(-0.6, 3.65)

ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=8)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', length=0)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
ax.xaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.25, linestyle=':', linewidth=0.5)
